s01516.summary: Lysandra kneels at the moon-well and asks the water for the way home.
A voice rises from the water, sending Lysandra to seek the one who kept her.
Morgwyn steps from the shadows; Lysandra draws her sword and the two recognize each other.
Morgwyn tells Lysandra the usurper on her throne is her sister.
Lysandra sheathes her sword and steps toward Morgwyn's magic doorway to a meadow.

s02231.summary: Priya is welcomed to the beige office by Halvorsen and his unenthusiastic team.
Priya probes the shared outlets, earned desks and secret metrics.
Appalled, Priya resigns herself to standing; Dutch offers his Monday outlet.
Halvorsen cheerfully launches into Q3 vision while everyone nods without interest.

s01383.summary: Four kids wait in the dusty projection tower with an old projector.
Flo and Henrik needle Cass about the projector; Pilar's camera clicks.
Cass hesitates, then throws the switch and the projector blazes to life.
A film of a woman on a porch plays; Pilar recognizes her grandmother.
Pilar rages at Cass for presuming to give her this private family gift.
Friends give Pilar quiet space as she photographs the screen and sits among them.

s01299.summary: The bowls green and its quirky regulars are introduced before the final end.
Harold and Dorothea trade barbs before the last end.
Harold bowls close; Dorothea answers by nudging the jack with her own bowl.
Umpire Tate rules the jack move legal over Harold's protests.
Basil measures the bowls and announces a tie, forcing an extra end.
Rivals agree to tea first and walk off together.

s02245.summary: At Sunday roast the twins squabble over a potato while adults scold.
Wilf prods the parents to tell the children Grandpa is moving in.
Peaches solemnly slides her potato to Bo, accepting the news.

s00398.summary: Six places are set at a stormy table with one plate empty.
Elspeth recalls a missing diner of 1963 while Roderick and Thaddeus dispute it.
Asked whose place is empty, Elspeth says it is for the one the tide brings.
In thunder and dark, a wet sardine appears on the empty plate.
Thaddeus asks what she has done; Elspeth says she invited him as something shifts below.

s01392.summary: The judge sits with the five Whitcombe heirs in her paneled chambers.
The heirs dispute whether a last will exists as the judge insists it is clear.
The judge silences the room and orders Pinkney to produce the envelope; Odette nods to Finn.

s02438.summary: A school bus is stalled on the tracks with bells clanging and lights flashing.
Remy and Zuri fight the jammed door, bicker, then heave it open as the train nears.
They sprint off the tracks as the train thunders past.
Panting in the gravel, Zuri calls Remy an idiot and he says you're welcome.

s01279.summary: A stranded group sits by a dead jeep on a blazing salt flat.
Thirsty and stuck, the group quarrels over the broken radiator until Bea stops them.
Sigrid spots a glint to the east that the others dismiss as mirage.
Perry studies the shape through binoculars and announces a slow man on a camel.
Cracked laughter breaks the tension and they resolve to wait as the figure nears.

s00052.summary: A maritime courtroom, a model ship and opposing counsel are introduced.
Grimsdyke delivers a theatrical closing, drawing objections and a skeptical judge.
The model ship's crane snaps; Grimsdyke milks it and the judge cuts him off.
Nakamura-Flynn holds the broken crane and argues it proves her case.
Grimsdyke despairs and the weary judge calls recess.

s01716.summary: Rival chili teams face off behind the cook-off stage.
Leroy and Dee loop through a circular argument over missing salt.
Rivals Harold and Wandy trade insults over thin chili, dragging in Leroy.
Leroy and Dee taste cinnamon and suspect the rivals sabotaged them.
Leroy accuses Harold and Wandy, who deny it and blame each other.
An airhorn sounds and all four call a furious silent truce.

s01669.summary: Magnussen ladles stew for weary soldiers in a bombed brewery.
Magnussen urges Petit to eat; Wojcik's dark joke about the stew draws a snort.
Petit hears a drumming noise that Greene identifies as distant artillery.
Magnussen settles and admits his father drank this brewery's beer, which is why he cooks here.
Wojcik whittles a tiny beer mug and Magnussen silently pockets it.

s02042.summary: A tearful lawyer hides in the night custodian's closet and he gently intrudes.
She admits her client is guilty and she lost her belief in him.
She laughs, gives her name Esperanza, and Mordecai offers dry wisdom.
Mordecai advises her to go home, sleep and do the work; she thanks him and leaves.

s01848_0.summary: Sheriff Pike walks through a dust storm, hears a piano and enters the saloon.

s02307.summary: Sim pries open a carousel unicorn while Beatrix watches the six-minute camera loop.
The unicorn hides ancient gold coins; Sim bites one and says it's real.

s00610.summary: Leo watches Mrs. Hargrove write a postcard to her husband who is long away.
Leo reads her card aloud; she admits its claim of being well is a lie.
Social worker Denise arrives late, and Mrs. Hargrove briskly gathers her postcards.
Leo returns the card and she gives it to him, asking someone to believe her.

s00421.summary: Kwabena discovers every sock is a left foot and the three blame one another.
Kwabena proposes shipping one pair to each customer as exclusive; Brenda and Priya mock it.

s00428.summary: Yara and crew tend the hydroponic ring while a filter keeps failing.
Uneasy about the filters, Yara orders a diagnostic on Ring Two.
Simeon's tablet reports a fifth crew member, then the intercom forbids the diagnostic.
Yara tries an override; Mother denies it and the seedlings lean toward her.
Lamps flare and vines attack, snaring Simeon as Lin slashes them.
Yara spins the manual hatch and the crew escapes and seals the vines inside.

s01459.summary: Curator Prudence makes night rounds with intern Zinnia among lit dollhouses.
Zinnia notices an attic doll has turned to face her.
Prudence sees the doll's chair rocking and its head turned toward them.
A yarn thread binds Zinnia to the doll; Prudence snaps it and the lights die.
They run as a hundred tiny lights wink back on.

s00301.summary: Silver gown woman locks the cloakroom door and confronts Ottoline about dancing with another.
Ottoline explains her cousin's dance request; Marguerite drapes the stole over her.
A knock forces them apart; Ottoline fixes her lipstick and Marguerite opens the door.

s02349.summary: Magda arrives in the ice warehouse to find the horse sculpture still there.
Magda berates the Driver over the wrong sculpture and the too-small van.
Magda wraps the horse in a thermal blanket and drills into its flank.
Magda reveals her real name is Esme and retrieves a pouch from the ice.
The Driver chooses the name Marcus and they roll the horse out.

s00670.summary: Otto toasts friends and pours brandy at a winding-down poker game.
Silas distrusts the brandy and leaves it untouched; Otto probes.
Otto deals the last hand and Tom collapses drugged; Ruby pockets the cards.
Fenwick enters with badge and revolver, telling Otto he has waited a year.
Otto smiles and Maude reveals a pistol under her knitting.

s01298.summary: Coach Bernie tells her battered team they cannot win, only lose with dignity.
Rookie Rajani says this is the best night of her life despite the score.
Teammates throw an ice pack and helmet in a laughing wrestling pile.
Bernie whistles them out to skate and murmurs 'Dignity' alone.

s01928_1.summary: Roz and Milo call deployed Calvin from a tent and share the moon.
Roz sends Milo to bed and they say goodnight; the call ends.

s00933.summary: The glass orchard sings at dawn as old Marguerite tends a tree.
A knight and a girl arrive by cart asking Marguerite for the key.
The Collector enters through the orchard and shatters Desmond's sword.
Lyra drops her lantern; its flame ignites the trees in blazing color.
The song swells joyfully and the Collector's mask cracks as he retreats.
Marguerite tells Lyra the lantern was ready and takes it.

s02398.summary: Three players struggle with a clue in a cheap escape room.
Chad flings the torch and all three tumble in a heap.
Moosa realizes the sarcophagus lid is a door hiding a brass key.
The key will not turn as the timer runs down; they struggle and the door opens.
They escape with four seconds left, celebrating.
